label: The recipe space
subgoals: Count the transform choices per step
Raise that count to the recipe length
Frame the next transform as an action on the current graph

label: A Q-learning update
subgoals: Add the reward to the discounted best next-state value
Subtract the current estimate to get the error
Move the estimate by the learning rate times the error

label: Shaping the reward
subgoals: Normalize each improvement by its original value
Weight and add the area and depth terms
Check the found recipe after technology mapping
